label: MV-372 2-channel GSM VoIP gateway
description: SIP-to-GSM gateway with 2 GSM channels (2 SIMs, 1 antenna) for VoIP-to-mobile and mobile-to-VoIP calls, no analog FXS/FXO ports, and a single 10/100 RJ-45 LAN port.
notes: PORTech user manual: MV-370 is 1 channel, MV-372 is 2 channels; 2 SIM slots, one antenna connector, one LAN RJ-45 (10/100BaseT, no gigabit). No FXS or FXO ports at all - the PSTN side is the cellular radio, so this box is 1 Ethernet port and nothing else. SIP based (RFC3261) and Asterisk-compatible; call termination and origination, 50 mobile-to-LAN and 50 LAN-to-mobile route entries. The radio is a GSM voice modem, not a wireless data interface, so no 'wireless' capability.
